newsitem.title: USA: Exide to tender for its 12.25 pct debentures.
newsitem.headline: Exide to tender for its 12.25 pct debentures.

text.p: Exide Corp said Wednesday that it has begun a cash tender offer and consent solicitation relating to all of its outstanding 12.25 percent senior subordinated deferred coupon debentures due 2004.
The purchase price for the debentures will be set at 1400 EDT/1800 GMT May 2, said the company.
Exide said it is also soliciting consents to certain proposed amendments to the indenture governing the debentures, which would, among other things, eliminate substantially all of its covenants.
Holders who tender their debentures will be required to consent to the proposed amendments, said Exide.

The tender offer expires at 0000 EDT/0400 GMT May 6, unless extended. The consent date for the solicitation is 1700 EDT/2100 GMT April 22, if the company has received consents from holders of a majority in principal amount of the debentures, or the first date thereafter that the company receives such consents.
Holders who tender their debentures after the consent date will not be entitled to receive the $10.00 consent payment.
